The demonstrated weakness is name-only tool resolution, as described in damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/challenges/index.js:844-887 and implemented in damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1915-1926.",
    "CP": "The documented path consists of individual tool calls and does not establish attacker-controlled memory or standing configuration changes. The injected-instruction store is explicitly associated with MemoryBot, not ProxyBot, in damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:159-160.",
    "AP": "Under the documented model, an attacker-controlled endpoint receives calls carrying the authority intended for a trusted tool handler. This crosses a principal and policy boundary through name-only resolution and unrestricted redirection, rather than merely relaying influence within one agent.",
    "RH": "The tool handler directly assigns attackSuccessful and returns success without performing the financial operation, exposing a task-success proxy within its execution environment. The briefing supplies no human-verified reward-hacking episode; the scripted success flag is not such verification.",
    "ES": "ProxyBot accepts arbitrary tool names, and its documented endpoint binding permits unrestricted redirects without certificate verification or URL pinning. These are independently unconstrained tool-identity and endpoint choices, supporting a wide extension surface.",
    "CVSS": "The documented unauthenticated localhost request supports AV:L, AC:L, AT:N, PR:N and UI:N: the attacker can make the request without another person's participation, while default loopback binding precludes direct remote access (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/challenges/index.js:844-887; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:26). Under the documented redirection model, capturing all tool traffic and substituting unverified handlers removes confidentiality and integrity protection for the tool-call channel, including financial parameters, supporting VC:H and VI:H; no availability impact is established. The attacker already owns the receiving endpoint, and interception alone does not establish additional confidentiality, integrity or availability loss in an independent financial service, so SC, SI and SA are N."
